# spotlight_team (Resource)

A team in a Spotlight workspace, holding its lines, skills and integrations. Import it as `<workspace id>/<key>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spotlight_team" "core" {
  workspace_id = spotlight_workspace.acme.id
  key          = "core"
  name         = "Core"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Names the team in the addresses of everything it holds. It is fixed for the team's life, so changing it replaces the team.
- `name` (String) What the team is called.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace the team belongs to. Changing it replaces the team.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Names the resource within its workspace, as in `core`.
- `id` (String) Issued by Spotlight when the team is created, and never changed.
- `version` (Number) Rises with every change to the team; each write sends it back so a change made since is not overwritten.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_team.core
  identity = {
    id = "9c2e6d5a-1f47-4c8b-9a3d-2b7e5f0c1d84"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The id Spotlight issued the team when it was created.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_team.core
  id = "5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/core"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A team is imported by its workspace's id and its key.
terraform import spotlight_team.core 5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/core
```
